subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how an author develops a character over the course of a text
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences character-moment cards to trace a change across a story's beginning, middle, and end
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a character's early behavior to how it contrasts with their later behavior
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a character changes across a text and identifies the events that caused the change

misconception_flags: describes a character's traits without connecting them to any specific development or change over the story

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
